documents.title: Introducción
documents.text: Healthcare Queue Management System A real-time queue tracking system for Outpatient Departments (OPD) in Myanmar hospitals.

documents.title: Problem
documents.text: Patients at Myanmar hospitals wait 3+ hours in crowded OPD waiting rooms with no visibility into doctor arrival or queue progression. They arrive as early as 7:00 AM for early token numbers, wasting time and exhausting already-sick individuals.

documents.title: Solution
documents.text: A mobile-optimized web app where: - Patients view real-time physician availability and queue status - Nurses manage tokens with a single click (start/complete) - The system sends automated notifications based on dynamically calculated wait times

documents.title: How It Works
documents.text: When a nurse completes a token, all downstream wait times recalculate instantly. Patients receive notifications as their turn approaches.

documents.title: Tech Stack
documents.text: Layer Technology --- --- Framework TanStack Start (React 19, SSR) Routing TanStack Router (file-based) Styling Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui State TanStack Query + Store Forms TanStack Form + Zod v4 Deployment Netlify Testing Vitest + Testing Library

documents.title: Key Routes
documents.text: Route Access Purpose --- --- --- / Public Select clinic, view queue /queue/:clinicId Public Live queue board /queue/:clinicId/token/:tokenId Public My token status /admin Staff Nurse dashboard /admin/session/:sessionId Staff Manage active session

documents.title: Deploy to Netlify
documents.text: 1. Push to GitHub 2. Import at app.netlify.com/start 3. Netlify auto-detects the build ( vite build → dist/client ) 4. Add environment variables in Site settings 5. Deploy
